title: Setup checklist
text:
Setup checklist

Extract ZIP to a normal folder
Install R
Install RStudio Desktop
Install Quarto
Open WA-Economic-Dashboard.Rproj
Run source("setup.R")
Run source("run_dashboard.R")
Open _site/index.html
Check the seven headline rows
Check the three ABS detail tables
Decide whether to configure automatic FuelWatch monthly averages
Upload project to GitHub
Enable GitHub Pages using GitHub Actions

title: Patch notes — v3.2
text:
Patch notes — v3.2

Fixed Quarto rendering failure caused by Python-style numeric formatting inside glue().
Sparkline endpoint coordinates are now formatted with sprintf() before being inserted into SVG.
Made FuelWatch monthly-table date sorting explicit and safer.
No changes to the successful ABS/Fuel Finder data-refresh logic from v3.1.
